name: Bina Puri Holdings Bhd
overview: 2026年，Bina Puri 完成了以 RM77.0 million 出售其在 KL-Kuala Selangor Expressway Bhd 的 50% 股权，并签署协议收购 Enforture (Sarawak) Sdn Bhd 全部股权（初始代价 RM100,000 加递延盈利挂钩代价）。公司与 Hanil Electric Co., Ltd. 的谅解备忘录年内无重大进展。此外，公司提出的债务重组安排（Scheme of Arrangement）获法院批准并已生效。
overview_en: In 2026, Bina Puri completed the disposal of its entire 50% equity interest in KL-Kuala Selangor Expressway Bhd for RM77.0 million and entered into an agreement to acquire the entire equity interest in Enforture (Sarawak) Sdn Bhd for an initial consideration of RM100,000 plus deferred profit-linked consideration. There was no material development on the memorandum of understanding with Hanil Electric Co., Ltd. during the year.

segments.name: 其他
segments.note: 年内完成出售 KL-Kuala Selangor Expressway Bhd 的 50% 股权，并推进收购 Enforture (Sarawak) Sdn Bhd。
segments.note_en: Completed the disposal of its 50% equity interest in KL-Kuala Selangor Expressway Bhd and progressed the acquisition of Enforture (Sarawak) Sdn Bhd during the year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以 RM77.0 million 现金完成出售 KL-Kuala Selangor Expressway Bhd 全部 50% 股权予 Arena Irama Sdn Bhd。
actions.text_en: Completed the disposal of its entire 50% equity interest in KL-Kuala Selangor Expressway Bhd to Arena Irama Sdn Bhd for a total cash consideration of RM77.0 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就收购 Enforture (Sarawak) Sdn Bhd 签署补充协议，因法律、财务、项目尽职调查及运营核实尚未完成。
actions.text_en: Entered into a supplemental agreement for the acquisition of Enforture (Sarawak) Sdn Bhd as legal, financial, project due diligence and operational verification had not been fully completed.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 签署有条件买卖协议，拟以初始现金代价 RM100,000 及递延盈利挂钩代价收购 Enforture (Sarawak) Sdn Bhd 全部股权。
actions.text_en: Entered into a conditional share sale and purchase agreement to acquire the entire equity interest in Enforture (Sarawak) Sdn Bhd for an initial cash consideration of RM100,000 and a deferred profit-linked consideration.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 年内推进债务重组安排，并与 Hanil Electric 的谅解备忘录无重大进展。
segments.note_en: Progressed the scheme of arrangement and reported no material development on the MOU with Hanil Electric during the year.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 法院批准的债务重组安排已于 2026 年 9 月 7 日提交马来西亚公司委员会，安排生效并对公司具约束力。
actions.text_en: The court-approved scheme of arrangement was lodged with the Companies Commission of Malaysia on 7 September 2026, and the scheme became effective and binding on the company.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 债务重组安排获出席并投票的债权人以 87.62% 价值比例批准。
actions.text_en: The proposed scheme of arrangement was approved by 87.62% in value of scheme creditors present and voting.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Hanil Electric Co., Ltd. 的谅解备忘录自上次公告以来无重大进展。
actions.text_en: There has been no material development on the memorandum of understanding with Hanil Electric Co., Ltd. since the last announcement.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 出售 KL-Kuala Selangor Expressway Bhd 全部 50% 股权，退出该联营/合资业务。
model_changes.text_en: Disposed of its entire 50% equity interest in KL-Kuala Selangor Expressway Bhd, exiting the associate/joint venture.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 拟收购 Enforture (Sarawak) Sdn Bhd 全部股权，将该公司纳入集团。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed to acquire the entire equity interest in Enforture (Sarawak) Sdn Bhd, bringing the company into the group.
